title: boe 0.3.0
text: boe_curve() gains , , frequency, cache_ttl_h arguments. Setting / , frequency = "monthly", routes request BoE archive zips, extend back ~1979 nominal gilts, ~1985 real, ~2000 commercial bank liability curve, ~2009 OIS. BLC published historical archive zip, requests always route archive path regardless / . New boe_curve_panel(curve, measure, frequency, , , maturities): wide-format wrapper returns one row per date one numeric column per pillar maturity. default pillar set c(0.5, 1, 2, 5, 10, 20), aligns exactly BoE half-year grid. Pillars outside curve’s published range trigger warning dropped. boe_curve() boe_curve_panel() gain segment argument. segment = "short" returns separately fitted short end curve (monthly maturity steps one month five years) every curve type; segment = "standard" (default) unchanged. Short-end history extends far back Bank published (1979 nominal gilts, later OIS); periods short-end sheet skipped rather erroring. panel’s default pillars become c(0.5, 1, 2, 3, 5) segment = "short". boe_curve_panel() now keeps pillar column labels aligned maturities match -grid pillar dropped; previously dropped pillar shift labels surviving column carried wrong name. Provenance: boe_tbl queries boe_curve() now record source = "latest" "archive" source_url data carries audit trail. Internal: archive zips cache 30 days (vs. 24 hours latest-month zip); per-period workbooks within archive concatenated transparently, content-based maturity-row detection older layouts.
